name: GDB Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，GDB Holdings Berhad 提出以 RM66.51 million 收购 Bina Tegas Sdn Bhd 51% 股权，并计划通过私下配售、附加股及凭单进行融资；同时，其全资子公司 GDB Development 拟以 RM32.72 million 收购三幅位于 Sarawak 的土地，其中一幅地块的收购因卖方未满足先决条件而终止。公司也宣布拟进行业务多元化。
overview_en: In 2026, GDB Holdings Berhad proposed to acquire 51% equity interest in Bina Tegas Sdn Bhd for RM66.51 million, to be funded via a proposed private placement and rights issue with warrants; concurrently, its wholly-owned subsidiary GDB Development proposed to acquire three parcels of land in Sarawak for RM32.72 million, with one parcel acquisition terminated due to the vendor's failure to fulfil conditions precedent. The company also proposed a diversification.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司提出收购 Bina Tegas 51% 股权、拟进行业务多元化，并推进三幅 Sarawak 土地的收购（其中一幅已终止）。
segments.note_en: The company proposed to acquire 51% of Bina Tegas, proposed a diversification, and pursued the acquisition of three land parcels in Sarawak (one of which was terminated).

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 509,072 收购 Bina Tegas Sdn Bhd 51% 股权。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of 51% equity interest in Bina Tegas Sdn Bhd for RM66,509,072, together with proposed private placement, rights issue with warrants, diversification and ESOS.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: GDB Development 向 Sport Pavillion Sdn Bhd 发出终止通知，终止收购 Lot 19102，因卖方未在期限内满足先决条件。
actions.text_en: GDB Development issued a notice of termination to Sport Pavillion Sdn Bhd to terminate the acquisition of Lot 19102 as the vendor failed to fulfil conditions precedent within the timeframe.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就上述土地收购签订补充协议，将取得土地转让同意及发展期限延长的时限从九个月修订为两个月。
actions.text_en: Entered into a supplementary agreement for the land acquisition, revising the timeframe to obtain land transfer consent and development extension from nine months to two months.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 GDB Development 与三方签订买卖协议，拟以 RM32.72 million 收购三幅位于 Sarawak 的土地，总面积约 21,926 平方米。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary GDB Development entered into sale and purchase agreements with three vendors to acquire three parcels of land in Sarawak totalling approximately 21,926 square metres for RM32.72 million.
